input.summary: Convert the mutual no-hire into a narrow 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering all of the other party's employees. We have narrowed this to a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with the customary carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months following the end of an individual's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement, neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to, directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement. This Section does not prohibit either party from hiring any person, and does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or to any person who approaches a party on his or her own initiative.
